target_text: Renewable units are often sited where resources are abundant, not where demand peaks
notes: Trailing not-X contrast of resource-sited vs demand-sited generation. That pair is not an ordinary-knowledge antonym (unlike true/false or purpose/accident); it is a checkable power-systems distinction that Rule 3 says must be its own sentence about what the siting is, not a bolted-on 'not where demand peaks'.
